Gain = the sealed test T5 (bench/results/read-test-v5.json), all pages of the test, `more`, net per 100 wrong words of the thorough mode minus the default model, paired by document (the Spanish 163 net fixes of `net_vs_none_es_dev` are the development, out-of-fold figure of cells-paired.json).
